description: Recover and validate broken structured output from LLMs and AI agents. Extract JSON hidden in prose or Markdown, repair malformed JSON, enforce a supplied JSON Schema, safely coerce optional types/defaults, report exact validation errors, and return a deterministic retry prompt when output still fails. Useful for tool calls, agent workflows, automation pipelines, and API integrations. Price: $0.01 USDC. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired tool result and does not run the tool. Payment is verified and settled before the tool runs.

applyDefaults.description: Apply default values from the schema.

removeAdditional.description: Remove fields excluded by additionalProperties: false.

rawOutput.description: Raw LLM or AI-agent output. Prose, Markdown fences, and malformed JSON are accepted.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 used to validate the recovered value.

name: recover_agent_output
